main_text.l: & Recentiorum per sua Phænomena explicatius tradens,

page.notes: The Greek title line and the author's Greek epithet are set in Greek letters as printed. The epithet "φιλίατρος" is a doubtful reading of a ligatured word, marked [?]. "De" is set in a swash script form. The rule between the date and the imprint is not text. Faint stains and the blue edge at left are not printed text and are omitted.
